The release goes out tomorrow morning; I'd rather it be correct than early.

decisions.question: Which build goes into the release when two builds report the same version
decisions.answer: Use the build made from the tagged commit, not one from a branch.

decisions.question: Whether the release notes should mention internal ticket numbers
decisions.answer: No ticket numbers in the release notes; customers read them.

decisions.question: Whether the platforms ship together or each as soon as it is ready
decisions.answer: Ship all three platforms together, even if that means waiting.
